capabilities: record task start, finish, and duration inline in Markdown checkbox lines
create, start, and finish a task with a single Toggle Task command
insert due routines into daily notes from plain routine notes with repeat shorthand
review tasks and a completed-activity timeline in one sidebar pane
apply optional spaced repetition growth to regular notes
disambiguation: Not a timer or alarm app; it only writes timestamps into Markdown task lines and explicitly excludes timers, notifications, and statistics.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later. SRS is experimental and off by default. Most spec documents are written in Japanese; the docs folder is designed to be fed to AI assistants for Q&A. Timers, calendar integration, and statistics are explicitly out of scope.
problem: Task plugins usually keep state in sidecar databases or need separate start/stop commands, so time records are not greppable plain text in the note itself.

relations.evidence: the same idea as Anki's handling of overdue cards
Install and enable the BRAT community plugin

summary: Task time tracker that records start and finish times inline in Markdown task lines, with routine insertion and a combined task/timeline sidebar.
